base.text:
**Consent to processing of personal data for the AI Qadam ID profile**

I give [OPERATOR: name, TIN/PINFL, address] my consent to process my personal data for one purpose: to keep my AI Qadam ID profile — the single member profile of the AI Qadam community, through which I log in to AI Qadam services and manage my consents.

**What data:** my Telegram ID; my Telegram first name, last name and username; the first and last name, position, company (if I give one), city and interface language that I enter myself; the dates the profile was created and completed, and the date of my last activity; my consents and their history. If I gave a phone number in the AI Qadam events bot before 14 September 2026, it is also kept in the profile — only to restore my access to the profile at my request if I lose my Telegram account. The number is given to no service.

**What is done with it:** collected, recorded, stored, changed, used for log-in and deleted. The data is stored on the servers of [PROCESSOR: hosting provider, name]. An encrypted backup copy is kept for up to 35 days in Cloudflare R2, in the European Union jurisdiction, **outside Uzbekistan**.

**What this consent does not give:** no AI Qadam service receives my data under this consent — each service needs my separate consent. Partners and sponsors do not receive my data.

**Term:** until I withdraw this consent or delete the account. If I do not use AI Qadam for 3 years, the profile is deleted; I am warned in Telegram through an AI Qadam bot 30 days before.

**Withdrawal:** at any time at id.aiqadam.org. Withdrawing this consent deletes my account in all AI Qadam services.

By pressing "I consent" I also accept the [Terms of Service]({terms_url}) (a public offer). More on data processing in the [Privacy Policy]({privacy_url}).

mailing.events.text:
**Consent to mailings of the AI Qadam events bot**

I give [OPERATOR: name, TIN/PINFL, address] my consent to send me announcements of new AI Qadam events in Telegram through the AI Qadam events bot. My Telegram ID is used for this.

This consent is optional: without it I can still register for events. I can withdraw it at any time in the settings. Term — until withdrawn or the account is deleted.
withdraw.base.text:
**Delete your AI Qadam ID account?**

Withdrawing the base consent deletes your account **in all AI Qadam services**. What happens:

- Your AI Qadam ID profile, all your consents and their history are deleted at once.
- The services you used get a request and delete their records about you. The events bot deletes registrations, tickets and attendance marks, feedback, quiz answers, mailing records and organiser rights, if you had any. AI Qadam Ask deletes [OPEN: W07]. This usually takes a few minutes, at most 3 working days.
- In encrypted backups the data stays until they expire: up to 14 days on the server and up to 35 days in storage in the European Union jurisdiction. If the database is ever restored from a backup, the deletion is applied again.
- Deletion cannot be undone. If you come back, the profile and consents will have to be created again.

**Withdraw your consent for {service}?**

{Service} will delete everything it keeps about you: {deleted}. It will stop receiving data from your AI Qadam ID profile, you will not be able to use it, and its mailings will stop too. Your AI Qadam ID profile and other services are not affected. The deletion cannot be undone.
